summary: Visual summary of per-criterion scores and the reviewer's recommendation.
whenToUse: Showing reviewers or organizers the scores recorded for a proposal.
whenNotToUse: Collecting or saving judgments: the component only displays data already provided.
accessibility: Criteria are a description list; scores use native meters with accessible labels.
responsive: Scores move below the criterion name in narrow spaces.
customization: Uses --dc-* tokens and className on the container.
commonMistakes: Passing a score outside the range defined by maxScore.
limits: Does not collect or persist scores.
